_help: Act 7, police headquarters (one action): Inspector Khalaf. The Italians' escape (trucks on the coast road, waiting for a permit) is found here; cooperating gives police_help (officers at the confrontation). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: khalaf
start.line: Another foreigner with a story about tombs. Very well. I am listening, because the sky tells me to.

a_italians.speaker: khalaf
a_italians.line: An Italian, Bellini, has applied for a permit to move four trucks of 'machine parts' out of the city on the coast road. I have not signed it. Yet.

a_none.speaker: khalaf
a_none.line: Suspicious cargo? All of Cairo is suspicious cargo this week. Nothing I can give you.

choices.label: Ask for his help
choices.line: When I find them, I'd like some of your men with me.

help.speaker: khalaf
help.line: Find them, and send for me. I would rather arrest thieves than bury citizens.
